title: 高分翻译背诵上海高考-45-26静安/黄浦

items.zh: 新政策适用于公司的所有部门。
items.en: The new policy applies to all departments of the company.

items.zh: 别把那个花瓶放在书架最上面，它可能会掉下来。
items.en: Don’t put the vase on the top of the shelf, or it might fall down.

items.zh: 冬日清晨，没什么比喝上一杯热气腾腾的豆浆更美妙的了。
items.en: On winter mornings, nothing beats a steaming cup of soy milk.

items.zh: 这位青年画家凭借细腻的笔触，迅速获得业界青睐，订单纷至沓来。
items.en: With delicate brushwork, the young artist has quickly won industry acclaim, with orders pouring in one after another.

items.zh: 虽然这座矗立于市中心的纪念碑形制朴素，但它作为历史的见证，始终塑造着我们的民族精神，激励着后人。
items.en: Although the monument standing in the city center is of simple design, as a witness to history, it has consistently shaped our national spirit and inspired generations to come.
